caption: The drawing depicts a plant with a central stem branching out into several curved stems, each ending in a large, rounded flower bud or seed pod. The flowers are composed of alternating dark blue and light blue-green sections, with small pointed protrusions at their tops. Several elongated leaves sprout from the stems; some are solid dark blue, while others are pale blue-green with dark blue central veins and serrated edges. Around the central plant, there are additional partial sections of stems, leaves, and flower buds extending in from the sides and corners, indicating a repeating or continuous design. The background is a pale, beige or off-white color. The overall arrangement is symmetrical, and the entire image appears to be rendered with thread, giving it the texture of embroidery rather than a conventional drawing. There are some areas of brownish discoloration near the edges and corners of the fabric.
title: Bed Hanging
